shipByAt.description: Suggested deadline with explicit offset and whole seconds, or null.

shipping.description: Structured configuration using carrierCode, serviceCode, packageCode, confirmation, weight, dimensions, insuranceOptions, internationalOptions, advancedOptions, requestedShippingService, paymentMethod, shipDate, and holdUntilDate; known IDs use strings.

orderedAt.description: Placement instant with explicit offset and whole seconds.

amountPaid.description: Amount paid in order monetary units.

orderNumber.description: User-defined order number, not the matching key.
